<?php
enum QuietEmptyGetCase: string { case Ready = "ready"; }
class QuietEnumEmptyGet {
    private int $value = 41;
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return true; }
    public function __get(string $incoming): object { global $reader, $selector; echo "G;"; $reader = null; $selector = "changed"; return QuietEmptyGetCase::Ready; }
    public function __destruct() { echo "RECEIVER;"; }
}
$reader = new QuietEnumEmptyGet;
$selector = "value";
$answer = empty($reader->$selector);
echo $answer === false ? "FALSE;" : "BAD_EMPTY;";
echo $reader === null && $selector === "changed" ? "CAPTURE;" : "BAD_CAPTURE;";
$again = QuietEmptyGetCase::Ready;
echo $again === QuietEmptyGetCase::Ready ? "SAME;" : "BAD_CASE;";
unset($again);
echo "DONE;";

<?php
enum QuietLiteralEmptyCase { case Ready; }
class QuietEnumLiteralEmptyGet {
    private int $value = 41;
    public function __isset(string $incoming): bool { echo "I;"; return true; }
    public function __get(string $incoming): object { global $held, $reader; echo "G;"; $saved = $held; $held = null; $reader = null; return $saved; }
    public function __destruct() { echo "RECEIVER;"; throw new Exception("receiver"); }
}
$held = QuietLiteralEmptyCase::Ready;
$reader = new QuietEnumLiteralEmptyGet;
$destination = 42;
try { $destination = empty($reader->value); echo "BAD_DELIVERY;"; }
catch (Exception $failure) { echo "CAUGHT;"; }
echo $destination === 42 ? "KEEP;" : "BAD_DESTINATION;";
echo $held === null && $reader === null ? "CLEARED;" : "BAD_CAPTURE;";
$again = QuietLiteralEmptyCase::Ready;
echo $again === QuietLiteralEmptyCase::Ready ? "SAME;" : "BAD_CASE;";
unset($again);
echo "DONE;";
